definitions.explanation: When content spreads rapidly online and gains significant attention. From English 'buzz'.

examples.japanese: この{動画|どうが}がバズった。
{彼女|かのじょ}のツイートがバズった。
バズることを{狙|ねら}って{投稿|とうこう}した。
examples.english: I posted it hoping it would go viral.

examples.japanese: バズった{動画|どうが}は{100万回|ひゃくまんかい}も{再生|さいせい}されたそうだ。
examples.english: I hear the video that went viral was viewed over a million times.

examples.japanese: SNSでバズると{一晩|ひとばん}でフォロワーが{何千人|なんぜんにん}も{増|ふ}えることがある。
examples.english: When something goes viral on social media, you can gain thousands of followers overnight.

notes:
バズる is a slang verb meaning to go viral online. Derived from English "buzz."

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
- バズる: dictionary form
- バズった: past tense
- バズらない: negative
- バズって: te-form

COMMON PATTERNS:
- SNSでバズる: to go viral on social media
- バズった{動画|どうが}: a viral video
- バズらせる: to make something go viral (causative)
- バズり{狙|ねら}い: aiming to go viral

RELATED WORDS:
- バズ: buzz, viral sensation (noun)
- {炎上|えんじょう}: going viral for negative reasons (online controversy)
- {拡散|かくさん}: spreading (of information)

REGISTER:
Internet slang. Very common among younger speakers and in social media contexts.
